notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Intruder Alarm and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve all but one Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
